summary: Validated email_notifications preference feature (buyer notification opt-in/out) end-to-end. Backend PATCH/GET /profile + /me persist the flag correctly, helper email_notifications_enabled defaults to True and reads False when set. Code review confirmed all 5 buyer notification send_* calls (bid confirmation, outbid, bid_removed, offer_auto_cancelled, second_chance_offer) are properly gated by `if await email_notifications_enabled(...)`. Frontend toggle at data-testid='profile-email-notifications-toggle' displays correct color state (gold=on/grey=off), toggles cleanly, and Enregistrer persists the value across reload. Non-regression of other profile fields (first_name, last_name, phone, date_of_birth) confirmed. Cleanup performed: buyer email_notifications reset to True.
